text:
irene: Partner Z reported that their hourly meter-forwarder failed to ack and retried entire hour -> we ingested duplicates before dedupe layer was rolled out. Affected window: 2026-03-22 01:00-03:00 UTC. Need quick coordination on mitigation + customer communication.
tom: ack. Preliminary numbers: ~15k embedding units, ~60k tokens across 4 SKUs. Mostly from APAC edge gateways.
samir: short-term mitigation: add an ingest-side idempotency check for (partner_id + gateway_id + hour_bucket). If duplicate detected, tag as dedupe_candidate and route to review topic. We'll also emit header `X-Redwood-Dedupe: candidate`.
billing: billing asks that any dedupe that affects invoiced cycles be exposed as a "pending_dedup" line on invoices and not auto-credited until reconciliation.
partner-ops: our side: gateways will start sending `X-Gateway-Seq` and `X-Gateway-Checksum` by next deploy (ETA 36h). Older devices can't, so we need server-side fingerprinting fallback.
ops-bot: suggested alert thresholds: dedupe_candidate_rate > 5k/min -> pgd, dedupe_review_queue > 10k -> ops-surge.
irene: runbook proposal: 1) immediate add server-side hour_bucket index and reject exact batch duplicates for 48h; 2) route rejected items to `partnerZ-dedupe-review`; 3) billing marks lines pending_dedup; 4) partner performs resend with checksum after fix.
samir: I'll open a small-canary patch to compute hour_bucket and index in redis with 72h TTL. ETA 12h for PR.
billing: I'll draft invoice messaging and the pending_dedup UX. ETA 48h.
partner-ops: we'll share sample failing batches and sign off on staging test. schedule call Wed 9am PT.
irene: thanks. action items: samir (ingest guard PR), billing (invoice UX), partner-ops (test vectors). We'll reconvene after staging run.
